faces.name: Bind the Monster
faces.oracleText:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature. It deals damage to you equal to its power.
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.

faces.name: Bind to Secrecy
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Counter target noncreature spell.
• Conjure a duplicate of target creature card in an opponent's graveyard into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.
If there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, draft a card from Bind to Secrecy's spellbook.
